decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY captures the stainless-steel material and render-matching appearance but omits the accepted custom-fabrication method.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Please move forward with that and match the render as closely as possible. I really like both the appearance and functionality shown in the render. There is also one change from the rendering: move the plate reading "[CLIENT_NAME_001]'s Matcha Mixer" from the back of the machine to the front. The spout and mixers will be positioned in front of the baristas, while customers will view the machine from another angle. I want "[CLIENT_NAME_001]'s Matcha Mixer" oriented toward the customer.

value_updates.appearance: match the supplied render as closely as possible

decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY for the independent placard position and customer-facing orientation; the spout-selection decision adds no branding change.
Selecting a custom render-matching spout does not change the requirement to deliver the prototype system layout in CAD.
The accepted spout material and fabrication method do not necessarily change the requirement to provide a basic wiring plan.
The spout-selection decision does not alter the existing splash-control target.
This candidate's off-the-shelf strategy is scoped to electronics, while the source selects a custom-fabricated mechanical spout.
The custom spout selection does not change bowl capacity, depth, refilling policy, or enclosure-size constraints.
The source decision does not change the required stability behavior or stabilization features.
Matching the spout to the render does not alter the established beige body and green accent colors.
The selected spout's material and fabrication method do not modify the independent requirement that the dispensing path be removable or easy to clean.
The spout-selection decision does not necessarily change the enclosure thickness, bowl-well accommodation, or overall size constraint.
Choosing a custom stainless-steel spout does not alter the existing leak-free connection and bowl-bottom sealing requirements.
